descriptions.w3d_component_step_8006bdf4: Forwards the object to a component step routine.
descriptions.w3d_component_step_second_8006be14: Forwards its second argument to the component step wrapper.
descriptions.w3d_handles_match_8006e10c: Returns whether two stored handles are equal.
descriptions.w3d_round_value_reset_8006e6f4: Checks whether the state is 5 or 7 and clears a global round value either way.
descriptions.w3d_scene_timer_is_one_8006e71c: Returns whether the scene timer's state equals one.
descriptions.w3d_scene_timer_set_8006e750: Passes a value by address to the scene timer's setter.
descriptions.w3d_handles_set_enabled_8006ee88: Stores an enabled bit and runs the enable routine when it is set.
descriptions.w3d_player_list_roster_80071e28: Returns the address of an embedded roster block.
descriptions.w3d_player_list_team_count_8008c34c: Returns the number of pointers in the first list (likely teams).
descriptions.w3d_player_list_worm_count_8008c440: Returns the number of pointers in the second list (likely worms).
descriptions.w3d_player_list_weapon_count_8008c534: Returns the number of pointers in the third list (likely weapons).
descriptions.w3d_player_list_refresh_8008cf14: Calls a refresh routine with zero, zero and a force flag of one.
descriptions.w3d_bonus_table_total_8008da54: Sums the first word of each of twenty 8-byte entries in a global table.
descriptions.w3d_player_list_timer_active_8008dd18: Returns whether the object's timer reports a non-zero state.
descriptions.w3d_player_list_add_score_a_8008e0cc: Adds an item's score value to the first running total.
descriptions.w3d_player_list_add_score_b_8008e108: Adds an item's score value to the second running total.
descriptions.w3d_selection_set_8008ed18: Stores a selected id and, when a target exists, applies the value to it and returns the result.
descriptions.w3d_record_owner_records_80090d7c: Writes the record count to the output and returns the first record, or null when there are none.
descriptions.w3d_pose_owner_set_pose_8009278c: Copies a pose (scale, then a three-word position) into the object.
